title: Module factorization component
statement: For every commutative coefficient ring Λ, scheme map k:W→S, module sheaf G on W, degree q∈ℕ, test object U étale over S, objects A,B of Over W and f:A→B, every module raw class z at B is sent by the raw Over functor to moduleSourceFactor(f.left,B.hom≫k,A.hom≫k,freeSheaf(Λ,S)(U)), followed by derived inverse image of z, followed by moduleCoefficientFactor(Λ,G,q,A,B,f).

source.place: Tags 03FD and 03Q8; explicit raw-map formula expansion

proof.text: Evaluate the concrete raw Over functor, its bundled additive map and the raw triangle pullback. The first two morphisms are shared as rawTriangleSource, and moduleSourceFactor uses that very construction. The remaining coefficient is the shared shift comparison at higherDirectImageRawOverComplex followed by the shifted higherDirectImageRawOverCoefficient, exactly moduleCoefficientFactor. Both sides are now definitionally equal, so rfl proves the unchanged statement. Proof irrelevance identifies the triangle proofs. No scalar-forgetting coherence theorem or coefficient-square theorem is used.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03FD and 03Q8; explicit maps, sharing the source and coefficient factors

theorem rawModuleScalar_pullback_module_formula
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)) :
    ((higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op z =
      moduleSourceFactor Λ f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map z ≫
        moduleCoefficientFactor Λ G (q : ℤ) A B f)
